added.title: Director, Software Development Engineering - PE Platforms
added.description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

Our engineering team builds, maintains and modernizes the platform capabilities that span the entire development and release lifecycle. The team’s portfolio includes core authoring frameworks, test engines, high-concurrency build & commit infrastructure and live system telemetry.

We operate at the intersection of platform, tooling & AI enablement for our large developer community internally. Our team is responsible for scaling our internal agentic AI platform and skills repositories to drive developer productivity, all while ensuring high availability for core delivery operations.

About The Role

As the Director of Software Engineering, Platforms PE, you will lead a global team of ~60 engineers, engineering managers and architects across California, Atlanta, Dublin and Chennai. Reporting directly to the VP of Platforms and based on-site at our HQ in Pleasanton, CA, you will serve as the leader for our global organisation.

In this role you will partner closely with our internal Product Management teams to build an agent-ready developer experience and delivery system. Your core mission is to scale build, test & release infrastructure to support an autonomous agentic development lifecycle.

If you have the following, we want to hear from you:

A deep understanding of systems engineering, platform reliability & innovation
A product mindset you bring to engineering & tooling
Led and scaled a multi-site engineering organization
Experience with agentic harnesses & AI products/infrastructure deployed in real-world environments
Proven capability to balance high-growth platform innovation with the systematic deprecation and migration of legacy systems.

About You

Basic Qualifications:

3+ years experience leading and developing senior software development engineering leaders (managers of managers) to build and scale large development organizations.
7+ years experience managing software development engineering teams, building high-performing teams and driving software development outcomes.
12+ years experience in software development engineering, defining and executing technical strategies for complex software products and platforms.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline; Master's degree preferred or equivalent practical experience.

Other Qualifications:

5+ years of experience mentoring engineering teams proficient in Java, Python, Go, or C++.
Experience managing high-throughput CI/CD build engines, Docker/Kubernetes, and AWS/GCP cloud infrastructure.
Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), execution harnesses, and automated PR review or triage systems.
Proven track record delivering automated testing engines, pipeline orchestration, and system observability frameworks.
Experience partnering with internal Product Management to operate platform tools as products.
Background leading, mentoring, and scaling global engineering organizations (~60+ engineers across time zones).
Ability to align technical strategy and influence cross-functional partners across Product, Security, and Architecture.
Strong skills delivering clear technical strategy presentations to executive leadership.

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. added.title: Director of Technology & Chief Architect
added.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Technology & Chief Architect based in United States.

This is a hands-on technology leadership role focused on shaping the architecture of a mature, high-volume cloud platform built around hundreds of Java microservices. You’ll take ownership of a production environment processing millions of real-time transactions each day, where performance, reliability, consistency, security, and auditability are critical. The role combines deep systems architecture with engineering leadership, allowing you to design systems, review code and schemas, establish technical standards, and guide long-term platform evolution. You’ll progressively take ownership across data, transaction processing, service architecture, and cloud infrastructure. Beyond technical execution, you’ll translate business priorities into a clear technology roadmap and communicate complex trade-offs to executives and stakeholders. This opportunity is suited to an experienced architect who wants meaningful ownership of a large-scale platform and its technical direction.

Accountabilities

Own the architecture of a large-scale microservices platform, progressively taking responsibility for service boundaries, APIs, data ownership, and inter-service communication.
Design high-volume, low-latency transaction systems with strong consistency, idempotency, resilience, and auditability requirements.
Define architectural patterns for distributed transactions, including sagas, outbox patterns, event sourcing where appropriate, retries, and failure recovery.
Lead architecture reviews, maintain architecture decision records, and establish consistent engineering standards across a large services ecosystem.
Identify architectural debt and develop modernization strategies for legacy services without disrupting live production traffic.
Establish Java engineering standards covering frameworks, libraries, build tooling, coding practices, JVM performance, and garbage collection.
Own database and data-platform strategy across relational, NoSQL, caching, and streaming technologies, including schema design, partitioning, replication, and capacity planning.
Guide cloud architecture across containers, Kubernetes, managed data services, networking, and infrastructure as code.
Establish SLOs, observability standards, incident response practices, and approaches to scalability, resilience, disaster recovery, and cloud cost efficiency.
Ensure security, data protection, and auditability align with applicable regulatory and payment-related requirements.
Build, lead, mentor, and grow engineering and technology teams while raising standards for technical hiring and development.
Translate business objectives into technology roadmaps and project plans, manage technical vendors and third-party platforms, and evaluate technologies that can improve the platform.
Communicate technology strategy, architectural risks, trade-offs, and priorities clearly to executives, business partners, and technical teams.

Requirements

12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years as an architect of large-scale distributed systems.
Expert-level Java experience, including Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, concurrency, JVM performance tuning, and garbage collection.
Proven experience designing and operating production environments with 100+ microservices.
Experience building or operating systems processing millions of real-time transactions per day against defined latency and availability targets.
Deep database expertise with relational platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle, including query tuning, indexing, sharding, and replication, combined with experience in NoSQL and caching technologies such as Cassandra, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or Redis.
Strong experience with event-driven architecture and Kafka or comparable streaming platforms.
Production experience with AWS or GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
Deep understanding of distributed-systems principles, including consistency models, idempotency, partitioning, backpressure, and failure modes.
Experience designing REST and gRPC APIs, API gateways, and service mesh architectures.
Strong observability and reliability experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or Datadog, along with SLO and incident management practices.
Proven ability to lead and develop engineering teams, evaluate technical candidates, and establish strong engineering practices.
Excellent communication skills with executives, peers, engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience in gaming, iGaming, sweepstakes/social casino, sports betting, fintech, or payments is a plus.
Experience with wallet, ledger, or payment systems requiring reliable transaction reconciliation is desirable.
Familiarity with gaming regulations, PCI DSS, SOC 2, or similar compliance frameworks is beneficial.
Experience modernizing monolithic or legacy systems into microservices with minimal or no downtime is a plus.
Knowledge of reactive or non-blocking Java technologies such as WebFlux, Vert.x, or Netty is beneficial.
Experience with large-scale cloud cost optimization and FinOps is desirable.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

Benefits

Base salary is negotiable and determined based on experience and skills.
Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
401(k) retirement plan, including any applicable employer match.
Paid time off and holidays.
Additional employee benefit and support programs.
Fully remote position based in the United States.
Opportunity to shape the architecture and long-term technology strategy of a high-volume cloud platform.
Significant hands-on ownership combined with executive-level technology leadership.
Collaborative, multidisciplinary environment with opportunities for technical and professional growth.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Job Summary

Nightingale is seeking a highly influential and inspiring Senior Manager of Design Engineering, New Product Innovation to lead the development of the next generation of healthcare lighting solutions. This is not a traditional engineering management role. We are looking for a leader who can create an environment where innovation thrives, teams are energized, and new ideas move rapidly from concept to reality.

The ideal candidate combines the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the ability to leverage the scale, resources, and capabilities of a global enterprise. They must be equally comfortable leading structured product development programs and facilitating creative exploration that challenges conventional thinking.

This leader will inspire and develop a team of seasoned engineers while serving as a catalyst across Product Management, Marketing, Manufacturing, Sales, Sourcing, Operations, and Design. Success requires balancing speed with rigor, vision with execution, and disruptive innovation with core portfolio growth.

The role will be central to Nightingale's mission of delivering purposeful innovation that improves patient and caregiver experiences while strengthening Nightingale's position as the category leader in healthcare lighting.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities (Essential Functions)

Inspire and Grow a High-Performance Team

Lead through vision, coaching, and empowerment, creating a culture of curiosity, ownership, accountability, and calculated risk-taking.

Develop seasoned engineers, build future leaders, and grow the team as the innovation roadmap expands.

Accelerate a Balanced Innovation Roadmap

Lead rapid concept development, iterative prototyping, validation, and commercialization across disruptive innovations, platform developments, and core portfolio priorities.

Enable fast, clear decisions while maintaining quality, reliability, manufacturability, profitability, and customer value.

Connect Acuity Innovation and Design Capabilities

Partner with Nexus, Acuity's Innovation Engine, to explore emerging technologies, evaluate breakthrough opportunities, and accelerate commercialization.

Collaborate with the Design Hub to deliver world-class industrial design, human-centered user experiences, and a cohesive Nightingale design language.

Integrate Engineering, Industrial Design, Product Management, and Marketing from early discovery through launch.

Lead Connected Healthcare Lighting and Controls

Apply strong knowledge of Acuity's nLight lighting controls platform to product architecture, system integration, application requirements, and roadmap decisions.

Bring working knowledge of low-voltage controls used in medical environments and patient rooms, including interfaces and workflows relevant to patient, caregiver, and facility needs.

Partner with controls, electrical, software, compliance, and application experts to create integrated solutions that are intuitive, reliable, scalable, and appropriate for healthcare environments.

Influence and Execute Across the Business

Inspire alignment across Marketing, Sales, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, Operations, and executive partners by translating technical possibilities into clear customer and business value.

Leverage Acuity's scale, resources, systems, and expertise without losing Nightingale's entrepreneurial speed and willingness to iterate.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nightingale New Product Innovation engineering from concept through commercialization.

Own engineering execution and resource priorities across multiple fast-paced product programs.

Build and mentor a growing team of experienced Design Engineering professionals.

Drive product architecture, mechanical and electrical design integration, prototyping, validation, and launch readiness.

Ensure effective integration of lighting and control solutions, including nLight and relevant low-voltage patient-room control systems.

Partner with Nexus, the Design Hub, Product Management, and Marketing to translate insights and technologies into differentiated products.

Engage Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Sourcing, and Quality early to deliver scalable, reliable, and profitable solutions.

Establish practical engineering standards and operating mechanisms that support both creative exploration and disciplined execution..

WHY Brands Inc., a parent company of Munchkin, Inc., focuses on creating, incubating, and growing the next generation of consumer lifestyle brands. Munchkin has sold billions of dollars of products through our key retail partners: Target, Walmart, and Amazon and has global distribution in over 50 countries. added.title: Head of Engineering
added.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a strong and experienced Head of Engineering to lead our engineering function and drive the successful delivery of scalable, secure, and high-performing technology products.

The ideal candidate must be a confident technical leader who can stand their ground, challenge decisions when necessary, take ownership, and hold teams accountable for delivery. You will be responsible for leading engineering teams, owning major technology projects, setting technical direction, and working closely with Product, Operations, and Executive Leadership to translate business goals into reliable technology solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can balance technical depth, people leadership, project ownership, and business priorities.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead, manage, and mentor engineering teams across multiple projects and product areas.
* Own the end-to-end delivery of major engineering projects, from planning and architecture to deployment and continuous improvement.
* Define and execute the engineering strategy in line with the organisation’s business and product objectives.
* Establish engineering standards, best practices, development processes, and delivery methodologies.
* Provide technical direction and make sound architectural and technology decisions.
* Work closely with Product, Design, Operations, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Take full accountability for engineering delivery, timelines, quality, reliability, and technical outcomes.
* Set clear expectations for engineers, track performance, and ensure accountability across the team.
* Review project progress, identify blockers early, and take decisive action to keep delivery on track.
* Challenge unrealistic timelines, requirements, or technical decisions when necessary and provide practical alternatives.
* Oversee code quality, system architecture, testing, deployment, monitoring, and overall engineering excellence.
* Ensure systems are scalable, secure, reliable, and capable of supporting business growth.
* Establish and maintain appropriate engineering documentation and technical standards.
* Drive continuous improvement across engineering processes, tools, and infrastructure.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, development, and retention of high-performing engineering talent.
* Manage engineering resources, priorities, and technical dependencies across projects.
* Identify and manage technical risks, security concerns, and potential system vulnerabilities.
* Ensure engineering practices align with relevant fintech, data protection, security, and regulatory requirements.
* Provide regular updates to executive leadership on engineering performance, project status, risks, and technology strategy.
* Stay informed about emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve the organisation’s technology capabilities.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of software engineering or technology experience, with significant experience in engineering leadership.
* Proven experience leading and managing engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience owning and delivering complex technology projects from conception to production.
* Strong software development background with the ability to engage deeply in technical discussions.
* Experience designing and scaling production-grade applications and systems.
* Experience working within a fintech, financial services, banking, payments, lending, or other highly regulated technology environment is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, security, and system scalability.
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum or similar software development methodologies.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of engineering metrics, delivery processes, and performance management.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Leadership Qualities

The successful candidate must be:

* Assertive and confident in making and defending technical decisions.
* Comfortable challenging ideas and pushing back when requirements or expectations are unrealistic.
* Accountable and willing to take ownership of both successes and failures.
* Strong enough to manage difficult conversations and hold team members accountable.
* Able to balance technical excellence with business realities.
* Decisive, structured, and solution-oriented.
* Capable of leading senior engineers while earning their respect through technical credibility.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* A strong mentor who can develop engineers into future technical leaders.

What Success Looks Like

* Engineering projects are delivered on time and to agreed quality standards.
* Engineering teams operate with clear ownership and accountability.
* Technology systems remain stable, secure, scalable, and reliable.
* Technical debt and engineering risks are actively identified and managed.
* Product and engineering teams collaborate effectively.
* Engineering priorities remain aligned with business objectives.
* The organisation has a strong engineering culture with clear standards and high performance expectations.

Proven experience managing engineering projects as well as maintenance operations.
Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and managing contractors/vendors.
Strong understanding of HSE, preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, and engineering compliance.
